items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Because I heard Johnny Hodges play, and it was just something about his playing and the tone of his instrument that just appealed to me.

ctx.x: What about your parents or anybody else in the family? Were your parents musically inclined?

No. No music in the family, except I. And I don't know how it got to me, how I became musically inclined. Well, I know how I become musically inclined. Because I heard Johnny Hodges play, and it was just something about his playing and the tone of his instrument that just appealed to me. And I had known musicians, plenty of musicians. Because at that time there was nothing else... Well, I don't mean nothing else. But I mean, that was about the main thing that Negroes could venture into. Because Big League ball…
